projects.title: Natural Gas Storage Valuation & Forecasting
projects.description: Prediction of natural gas storage valuation using machine learning regression models.
projects.details: Built a natural gas price forecasting model using 48 months of historical market data, achieving an RMSE of 0.1997 and MAE of 0.1498. Simulated storage contract strategies to identify profitable injection and withdrawal periods, resulting in an estimated contract value of $1,590. Utilized Python for forecasting, valuation, and financial analysis.
projects.tech: Python - Pandas - Visualization - Machine Learning - Regression - Forecasting - Risk Analysis

projects.details: Developed a credit risk assessment model to predict default probabilities and calculate FICO scores based on historical financial data. Achieved high accuracy in identifying risky borrowers and provided actionable insights for loan underwriting decisions.
